rules.contract: This contract is Preview Design only and creates no current lexer, parser, AST, HIR, MIR, runtime, formatter, or product route.
Persistent slots require explicit static#slot declarations; plain let and var retain activation-local meaning and migration never reinterprets them.
FUNCTION_STATIC_NAMESPACE is a fifth closed compile-time lookup domain with no fallback into nominal, extension, Trait, provider, or runtime-value domains.
A function-static namespace is not a first-class value and cannot be imported, used, exported, aliased, reflected, wildcard-selected, or addressed through another callable.
M0 publishes only immutable static-materializable no-drop values with no interior mutable state, Resource, authority, escaping borrow, finalizer, or unload responsibility.
SharedCell, SharedMutex, persistent registries, and other mutable carriers are not smuggled through the M0 immutable slot profile.
Slot initialization is source ordered; only prior staged slots are visible and self, forward, cycle, and hidden topological reorder are rejected.
Initializer staged-slot reads and ordinary Ready-slot reads are distinct typed HIR and MIR responsibilities.
All slots and Ready publish atomically after the entire activation succeeds; failure cleans reverse order, publishes zero slots, and retains one cached terminal failure identity.
Move, consume, exclusive borrow, assignment, compound assignment, implicit locking, and implicit atomicity are absent.
Slot and owner identities are semantic, reproducible, specialization-separated, collision-checked, and independent of source path, order, addresses, machine code, inlining, LTO, and JIT identity.
A lexical descendant reference is a static owner/slot dependency, never a stack capture or a new first-class namespace value.
Module API residue binds ordered slot semantics and dependencies while excluding backend-local symbols, entries, addresses, and indices.
Stable activation failure, reentry, owner, ordering, and publication diagnostics retain their existing identities.
Semantic P0 remains zero, the exact OPEN P1 set remains 22, this Preview closes or creates no P1, and all 15 product lanes remain NOT_RUN.
